name: Administrator access remains secure
description: Confirms the ClassBridge opening screen is branded and the configured owner can access administration.
steps: Open ClassBridge and confirm the splash screen displays Built by Favour
Sign in as the configured administrator

name: Student profile and picture persist
description: Checks that a student can update their display name and photo.
steps: Sign in as an approved student
Change name and upload an image
expected: The updated name and picture remain visible.

name: Community chat sends live messages
description: Checks that approved members can exchange messages.
steps: Sign in as an approved student
Open the chat as another approved member
expected: The message appears with the sender's name and role.

name: Teacher uploads class materials
steps: Sign in as an approved teacher
Open Class material as an enrolled student
expected: The file is listed and can be opened by enrolled students.

name: Student shares ClassBridge links
description: Checks that students can share or copy the ClassBridge website and app-entry links.
steps: Sign in as an approved student
Use Share website link and Copy app link
expected: The device share sheet opens where supported, or the correct ClassBridge link is copied; the section explains that a separate APK is not yet available.

name: Existing classroom workflows remain available
covers: teacher creates Google Meet live class session
student joins a published live class
student attendance totals and missed class summary
description: Protects existing classroom, assignment, live lesson and attendance workflows.
expected: Existing classroom, assignment, live class and attendance features continue to work.
